levels.title: L1 · SELECT & WHERE
levels.goal: Pick columns, filter rows, sort, cap. The MCQ bread-and-butter.

levels.title: L2 · Aggregates & GROUP BY
levels.goal: Collapse rows to numbers; bucket then filter buckets.

levels.title: L3 · JOINs (the coding slot)
levels.goal: Glue 2-3 tables. The AXIS SQL coding question lives here.

levels.title: L4 · Subqueries
levels.goal: Overall vs per-group; membership vs existence; the NULL trap.
skills: NOT IN + NULL trap -> NOT EXISTS

levels.title: L5 · Sets, CASE & DML
levels.goal: Combine result sets; bucket per row; change data.

levels.title: L6 · Windows, CTEs & Dates
levels.goal: Rank, accumulate, average durations, convert views to rates.

levels.title: L7 · AXIS Mocks
levels.goal: Full-slot simulations: 3 tables + GROUP + HAVING + subquery.

examNote: AXIS 2026 coding slot = 3 Qs in 60 min (DSA + SQL JOINs on 2-3 tables + UI). Clear = 2 complete + 1 partial. SQL slot is medium: chain JOINs, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY. This arena orders 34 problems L1->L7 so each level unlocks the next.
